item.tib: gsang mchog rol pa'i rgyud las mnga' gsol byin rlabs bkra shis shugs ldan gyi le'u
item.coloph: ces gsang mchog dbang gi rgyud las/ mnga' gsol bkra shis byin rlabs shugs ldan 'di/ mkha' 'gro zil gnon dbyings phyug mas/ snyigs ma'i kho bo byang chub rdo rje rtsal gyis (gyi) snyan du brgyud pa'o/ me lug zla tshes bzang ba'i nyin/ shel brag mngon dga' rtse ru bkod pa mang+ga lam//
